title: Save and reopen
goal: Cmd/Ctrl+S persists the document as a self-contained .html; reopening yields the identical state on every target.
scope: Chromium: showSaveFilePicker on first save, silent re-save with the remembered handle in the session
Safari, Firefox, iOS, Android: download via Blob + a[download], file name from the title slug + ".html"
Dirty indicator; beforeunload warning only when dirty; pending event flushed before save
Saved file = webdoc.toHTML() (E1-005); no data in URL parameters

rules.rule: A saved file opens offline with 0 network requests and an identical hash.
Platform limitations are documented in README.

criteria: On each of the 5 targets: scenario → save → open the saved file in a fresh context → equal hash, equal text, engine bytes equal dist.
Chromium: the second save overwrites the same file without a picker.
A file saved on target A opens on every other target with an equal hash (5 × 5 matrix).
iOS: the download lands in Files (simulator container listing); the opening behaviour is documented (R4).
